stim_id.Description: Stimulus identifier; equal to the BIDS task label (task-stimNN) of the recordings that show it.

task.Description: BIDS task label of the recordings that show this stimulus.

source_title.Description: Title of the source work or upload.

source_id.Description: Identifier of the source (YouTube id, archive or deposit identifier, clip name).

source_url.Description: Where the source can be obtained (official page, upload or deposit). Not a copy made by us.

rights.Description: Rights note. 'third-party; not included': the video belongs to its rights holder and is not part of this dataset.

presented_duration_s.Description: Presented duration measured from this dataset's own start/end markers (median over recordings).

source_duration_s.Description: Duration of the source upload or file named in source_id.

source_in_s.Description: Where the presentation starts inside the YouTube upload; n/a when not verifiable.

verification.Description: How identity and timing were checked.

Levels.verified: identity and start checked against this dataset's pupil data
Levels.likely: identity verified; start from video content, one weak pupil anchor
Levels.unknown: identity from the documentation only; start or presented version not verifiable
